Animaniacs.name: Animaniacs
Animaniacs.summary: Game Boy port of Animaniacs (Sega Genesis/Mega Drive).

Dangan GB.name: Dangan GB
Dangan GB.summary: Dangan GB is a short simplistic boss-rush/bullet-hell shmup released for the Game Boy to celebrate the console's 30th anniversary.

Darkman.name: Darkman
Darkman.summary: A side-scrolling platformer based on the 1990 Sam Raimi film. Players control Darkman through action levels, using disguises that dissolve in sunlight to impersonate gangsters and gain their abilities. Between levels, a photography minigame determines how much time is granted for the next stage.

Elevator Action.name: Elevator Action
Elevator Action.summary: You are Agent 17 (codename: "Otto"). Your mission is to secure all top secret documents from a security building and escape in the getaway car, located in the basement of the building. Gameboy version of the Arcade game "Elevator Action".

Mind Bender.name: Brain Bender
Mind Bender.summary: In Brain Bender, mirrors are manipulated in order to get them to reflect a laser beam into some balls of gas and destroy the satellite. Brain Bender features 120 different puzzles to solve.
